fixes.was: A corporation with an imputed racial identity may sue under 42 U.S.C. § 1981 for discrimination in contract performance, and nominal damages can support punitive damages, but the punitive amount must satisfy constitutional limits of reprehensibility, ratio to harm and comparable sanctions.
fixes.now: A corporation with an imputed racial identity may sue under 42 U.S.C. § 1981 for discrimination in contract performance, and a nominal-damages award does not show absence of injury, but a punitive award must satisfy constitutional limits of reprehensibility, relation to harm and comparable sanctions.
